summary.text: Suzanne Fortenberry is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election. She works as a delivery driver.

paragraphs.text: Suzanne Fortenberry earned a high school diploma from Tallulah Academy/Delta Christian School, and her career experience includes working as a delivery driver.
She was a candidate for Indiana State Senate District 36 in 2024, losing the general election, and she advanced from the Democratic primary for House District 57 on May 5, 2026.
